paragraphs: R' Yochanan son of R' Yoshiyah.
He is mentioned in the Mekhilta, Mishpatim, section 15; but Hyman calls it a scribal error and says one should read R' Achi son of R' Yoshiyah, as in the Yalkut there.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״טו is neutral section 15, without resolving parashah/perek or verifying a modern edition. ט״ס is conventionally scribal error, not the unsupported ta’ut defus expansion.

Yochanan-to-Achi is Hyman’s definite correction and claimed Yalkut support, not a fresh collation or adopted identity. The stray כ in an earlier note is absent from the source. Both father-title components are preserved; all four abbreviated titles remain R'.
